title: Visual Asset
description: A format-agnostic image record. The RECORD carries the meaning; the file is swappable — a sketch today, a HABS photograph tomorrow, a commissioned render later. Records are authored BEFORE the file exists, with status 'wanted' and a shot spec, so the gap is visible rather than silent and an agent can already use the record. The alt_text is the machine-readable form of the picture and is required on every record, file or no file.

kind.description: What sort of picture it is. Deliberately wide: the right medium differs by subject, and a rule diagram, a built example, and a millwork section are not interchangeable.

role.description: correct / incorrect are the good-and-bad pair that does the teaching. Pair them with pair_with.

pair_with.description: id of the opposing record. A correct/incorrect pair must reference each other.

depicts.description: What the image is ABOUT. These bindings are how an agent finds the right picture, and how a slot or fault surfaces its illustration.

members.description: specific assembly member ids, e.g. corinthian.entablature.corona

caption.description: What a reader sees under the image. One or two sentences, and it should make the teaching point, not merely name the building.

alt_text.description: A precise verbal description of what the image shows, written so that a model with no access to the file can reason from it. On a 'wanted' record this doubles as the shot spec — it tells a photographer or renderer exactly what must be in frame.

shot_spec.description: Present on wanted records. What has to be true of the picture for it to do its job.

vantage.description: e.g. 'square-on elevation, no perspective convergence', 'raking light from the left to read profile depth'.

scale_cue.description: How the viewer will judge size — a person, a door, a dimensioned rule.

habs_number.description: Historic American Buildings Survey reference, where applicable. HABS material is public domain and professionally measured.

license.description: Never ship an asset at 'unknown'. The validator warns.

file.description: Null while status is 'wanted'. Format-agnostic by design.

generated_from.description: Set when the image is a render of a rule rather than a picture of a building. A diagram produced by the proportion engine records its inputs here, so it can be regenerated exactly and so the drawing and the data can never silently disagree.

status.description: wanted: specified, no file. sourced: file present, unreviewed. approved: reviewed and correct. rejected: kept so the same wrong image is not sourced twice.
